blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. We further introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM. Across multiple MoE architectures and diverse reasoning tasks, both RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM consistently outperform strong baselines, while RoCo-PRM transfers effectively across both model architectures and tasks. Our findings suggest that expert routing is more than a computational dispatch mechanism: it provides an architecture-native source of process supervision for reasoning.
blocks.zh: 过程奖励模型(PRMs)为多步骤推理提供了精细的监管,然而获得可靠的过程标签仍然是一个核心瓶颈. 现有办法通常依靠人的注释、以推出为基础的估计或辅助核查。 在这部作品中,我们探索了一种不同的过程监督来源,由Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)模型在本土曝光:专家出行. 我们显示,简单的路由统计提供了一种固有的进程自信信号,与传统的产出-记录信心具有竞争力。 在这个观察的基础上,我们通过结合总体的路由质量,头道质量,以及步内路由变异,构建出出通向信心,并引入了RoCo-Rethin,它确定了最不自信的推理步骤,有选择地再生了之后的轨迹. 我们进一步引入了RoCo-PRM,它使用一个强大的MOE来自动对有路由衍生出步分数的推理轨迹进行注释,并将其分馏成独立的PRM. RoCo-Rethink和RoCo-PRM在多个教育部架构和各种推理任务中,都一贯超越强基线,而RoCo-PRM则在模型架构和任务中有效转移。 我们的研究结果表明,专家的路由不仅仅是一个计算调度机制:它为推理提供了一种结构内在的程序监督来源。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have made rapid progress on multi-step reasoning tasks, yet their reasoning trajectories remain highly fallible. A model may proceed correctly for several steps before making an error that propagates through the rest of the solution. This has motivated increasing interest in process supervision , where intermediate reasoning states are evaluated rather than assigning feedback only to the final outcome. Process reward models (PRMs) have consequently become an important component of reasoning verification, test-time search, self-correction, and reinforcement learning ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Setlur et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在多步推理任务上取得了快速进展,然而其推理轨迹仍然极易失传. 一个模型可能会正确进行若干步骤,然后才产生一个错误,通过其他解决方案传播。 这促使人们越来越关注过程监督,即评估中间推理状态,而不是只给最终结果提供反馈。 过程奖励模型(PRM)因此成为推理验证,测试时间搜索,自我校正和强化学习的重要组成部分(Lightman等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;Setlur等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2026年).

blocks.en: A fundamental challenge is where such process supervision should come from. Existing approaches obtain process supervision from human annotations, rollout-based estimation, automated verification, outcome-derived supervision, or model-internal uncertainty signals ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025b ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025a ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026a ) . While recent automated methods substantially reduce dependence on manual annotation, they often require additional evaluation computation, outcome signals, or auxiliary evaluators. Comparatively little attention has been paid to architecture-native computation signals that arise naturally during a single forward pass. This is particularly relevant for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where routers continuously map hidden representations to sparse expert allocations. These routing decisions are produced intrinsically during ordinary inference, raising the central question of this work:
blocks.zh: 一个根本性的挑战是,这种过程监督应当从何处产生。 现有方法从人的说明、推展估计、自动核查、结果产生的监督或模型-内部不确定性信号(Lightman等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;Sun等人,2025年b;Tan等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年;Yuan等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年a;Cao等人,2026年a)获得过程监督。 虽然最近的自动化方法大大减少了对人工注释的依赖,但它们往往需要额外的评价计算、结果信号或辅助评价人员。 相对而言,很少注意在一次前行中自然产生的结构内在计算信号。 这与专家混合模型特别相关,其中路由器不断将隐藏的表示图映射到稀少的专家分配. 这些路线决定是在一般推论中内在产生的,提出了这项工作的中心问题:

blocks.en: Can native MoE routing serve as intrinsic process supervision for reasoning?
blocks.zh: 本土的教育部路线能否作为推理的内在过程监督?

blocks.en: There are both architectural and empirical reasons to believe that it can. Given a hidden state h t h_{t} , token prediction and expert routing can be viewed as two distinct projections of the same latent representation: h t → W LM p ⁡ ( v ∣ h t ) , h t → W router p ⁡ ( e ∣ h t ) . h_{t}\xrightarrow{W_{\mathrm{LM}}}p(v\mid h_{t}),\qquad h_{t}\xrightarrow{W_{\mathrm{router}}}p(e\mid h_{t}). (1) The former reflects uncertainty over what token to generate next, whereas the latter reflects how computation is allocated across experts. Recent work further shows that native MoE routing preserves structured information about latent reasoning states beyond the emitted trace ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . This motivates us to ask whether routing behavior can be compressed into a lightweight process-confidence signal and further converted into reusable process supervision.
blocks.zh: 无论是建筑学还是经验学都认为它可以. 鉴于隐蔽状态 h t h_{t},符号预测和专家的路由可视为对同一潜在代表的两种不同的预测: h t → W LM p → (v → h t), h t → W 路由器 p → (e → htt) 。 h_{t}\xrightarrow{W_{\mathrm{LM}}}p(v\mid h_{t}),\qquad h_{t}\xrightarrow{W_{\mathrm{router}}}p(e\mid h_{t}). (1) 前者反映对下一步产生什么标志的不确定性,后者则反映如何在专家之间分配计算。 最近的工作进一步表明,教育部的原生路线保存了关于排放痕迹以外潜在推理状态的结构化信息(Chen等人,2026a); 陈等, 2026b ). 这促使我们询问,路由行为是否可以压缩成轻量级过程自信信号,并进一步转化为可重复使用的过程监督.

blocks.en: We investigate this through routing confidence , which combines three complementary routing statistics at each reasoning step: overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation. Across multiple MoE architectures and reasoning domains, these statistics exhibit systematic relationships with step-level reliability, and routing-based predictors often outperform conventional output-side confidence signals.
blocks.zh: 我们通过路由自信来调查这一点,它结合了每个推理步骤的三个互补的路由统计:总体路由质量,头部路由质量,以及步内路由变化. 在整个教育部的多个架构和推理领域,这些统计数据显示出系统关系,具有步态可靠性,基于路由的预测器往往比常规输出端信任信号要好。

blocks.en: Building on this signal, we introduce RoCo ( Ro uting Co nfidence), with two instantiations. RoCo-Rethink directly uses routing confidence at test time to identify the least confident reasoning step, preserve the preceding prefix, and regenerate the subsequent trajectory. RoCo-PRM uses a strong MoE teacher to annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM that scores reasoning steps without access to routing information.
blocks.zh: 基于这个信号,我们引入RoCo(Ro uting Co nfience),有两个即时信号. RoCo-Re think直接使用测试时的路由自信来识别最不自信的推理步骤,保留前缀,再生后续的轨迹. RoCo-PRM使用一个强力的MOE老师,用路由衍生的步数分数对推理轨迹进行注释,并将其蒸馏成一个独立的PRM,在无法获得路由信息的情况下对推理步骤进行分数.

blocks.en: Empirically, RoCo-Rethink consistently outperforms strong test-time reasoning baselines, while RoCo-PRM consistently surpasses automatic PRM baselines, including when applied to dense target models. Further analyses show that composite routing confidence more reliably identifies revision points with high corrective value and that RoCo-PRM benefits more from stronger routing teachers than from larger PRM backbones.
blocks.zh: 经验性地说,RoCo-Rethink一贯超越强大的测试时间推理基线,而RoCo-PRM则一贯超过自动PRM基线,包括在应用于密集目标模型时. 进一步的分析表明,综合路线信心更可靠地确定具有高修正价值的修订点,而RoCo-PRM从更强大的路线教师中受益多于较大的路线管理骨干。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are fourfold.
(1) We introduce a lightweight step-level routing-confidence formulation that combines three complementary statistics from native MoE routing.
(2) We develop RoCo-Rethink, which uses routing confidence to identify error-prone reasoning steps and selectively regenerate the subsequent trajectory.
(3) We introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM that can guide both MoE and dense target models.
(4) RoCo-Rethink outperforms the strongest test-time baseline in all 18 evaluated settings, while RoCo-PRM achieves the best or tied-best performance in all 30 settings.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献有四倍。
(1)我们采用轻量级阶梯式的路由自信公式,结合了来自本土教育部路由的三个互补统计数据.
(2)我们开发了RoCo-Rethink,它利用路由自信来识别容易出错的推理步骤,并有选择地重新生成后续的轨迹.
(3)我们引入RoCo-PRM,它使用强力的MOE来自动将路由衍生步骤分数的推理轨迹进行注释,并将其蒸馏成独立的PRM,既能引导MOE,又能引导密集的目标模型.
(4)RoCo-Rethink在所有18个被评价的设置中都超过了最强的测试时间基线,而RoCo-PRM在所有30个设置中都取得了最佳或捆绑的最佳性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Process Supervision and Process Reward Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 过程监督和过程奖励模式

blocks.en: Process supervision provides fine-grained feedback on intermediate reasoning steps and has become an important paradigm for improving multi-step reasoning. Early work demonstrates the effectiveness of human-annotated process supervision ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , while subsequent studies construct process supervision automatically through rollouts, outcome-derived signals, automated verification, or model-internal uncertainty ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Setlur et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025b ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025a ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026a ) . Many of these approaches nevertheless require additional evaluation computation, outcome information, or auxiliary evaluators. In contrast, we investigate whether process supervision can be derived directly from architecture-native routing dynamics arising during ordinary MoE inference.
blocks.zh: 过程监督为中间推理步骤提供了精细的反馈,已经成为改进多步骤推理的重要范例. 早期工作证明了人附加说明的流程监督的有效性(Lightman等人,2024年),而随后的研究则通过推出、结果产生的信号、自动化核查或模型-内部不确定性自动构建流程监督(Wang等人,2024年;Setlur等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年b;袁等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年a;Tan等人,2026年;赵等人,2026年;Cao等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年a). 然而,其中许多方法需要额外的评价计算、结果信息或辅助评价人员。 相反,我们调查过程监督能否直接从普通教育部推论中产生的结构-内在路由动态中得出。

blocks.en: 2.2 MoE Routing as a Reasoning-State Signal
blocks.zh: 2.2 教育部作为理由状态信号的运行

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts models dynamically route tokens to sparse subsets of experts, with prior work largely focusing on routing efficiency, load balancing, and expert specialization ( Fedus et al., 2022 ; Dai et al., 2024 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . More recent studies suggest that routing also reflects latent reasoning dynamics. Chen et al. (2026a) show that routing retains information about task context and trajectory state even when emitted tokens are controlled, while Chen et al. (2026b) demonstrate that native routing can recover structured representations of latent reasoning states. Complementary studies further connect routing behavior with reasoning reliability and the consequences of routing interventions ( Yoon et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Building on this emerging view, we ask whether routing information can be compressed into a lightweight step-level confidence signal and further converted into reusable process supervision.
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts模型向稀少的子集专家动态路标,先前的工作主要侧重于路由效率、负载平衡和专家专业化(Fedus等人,2022年;Dai等人,2024年;Muennighoff等人,2025年)。 最近的研究显示,路线也反映了潜在的推理动态。 Chen等人(2026a)表明,即使排放的信号被控制,路线仍然保留关于任务背景和轨迹状态的信息,而Chen等人(2026b)表明,本土路线可以恢复潜在推理状态的结构化表述。 补充研究进一步将路由行为与推理可靠性以及路由干预的后果联系起来(Yoon等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年). 基于这种新出现的观点,我们问道,路线信息是否可以压缩成轻量级的阶梯置信信号,并进一步转化为可重复使用的流程监督.

blocks.en: 2.3 Test-Time Reasoning Guidance
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 试验时间理由指南

blocks.en: Test-time reasoning methods improve model performance by allocating additional computation to uncertain or difficult parts of a reasoning trajectory. General self-correction frameworks iteratively critique, revise, or regenerate model outputs ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , while more recent work uses localized confidence or process verification to determine when and where additional reasoning is needed ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Chang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . These approaches demonstrate the value of fine-grained reliability signals for adaptive reasoning guidance, but typically rely on output-side confidence or separately trained evaluators. In contrast, RoCo-Rethink derives its guidance signal directly from native MoE routing and uses it to identify low-confidence reasoning steps for targeted regeneration.
blocks.zh: 测试时间推理方法通过将额外计算分配给推理轨迹的不确定或困难部分来提高模型性能. 一般自我更正框架反复批评、修订或再生模型产出(Madaan等人,2023年;Shinn等人,2023年;Gou等人,2024年),而最近的工作则利用局部信任或过程核查来确定何时何地需要额外推理(Yao等人,2024年;Chang等人,2025年;Lee等人,2026年b;Jin等人,2026年)。 这些方法表明精细的可靠性信号对适应性推理指导的价值,但通常依赖产出方信心或经过单独培训的评价人员。 相比之下,RoCo-Rethink直接从原生的MOE路由中获取其指导信号,并利用它来识别有针对性再生的低信心推理步骤.

blocks.en: 3 Understanding MoE Routing as a Process Signal
blocks.zh: 3 理解MOE 运行为进程信号

blocks.en: We first examine whether native MoE routing tracks step-level reasoning reliability and provides a competitive alternative to conventional output-side confidence. Based on these observations, we construct a lightweight routing-confidence signal for reasoning guidance and process supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查原产地教育部的路由是否跟踪阶梯级推理可靠性,并提供一个替代传统产出方信心的竞争性选择。 基于这些观察,我们构建了一个轻量级的路由自信信号,用于推理指导和过程监督.

blocks.en: We first ask whether these routing statistics systematically track intermediate reasoning quality. Using within-trajectory Spearman correlation, we compare their relative ordering with scores from external process verifiers across three MoE architectures and multiple reasoning domains. For mathematical tasks, we use two independently trained math PRMs as references ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) ; for MMLU and code reasoning, we use VersaPRM and CodePRM, respectively ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . The same directional pattern persists across independent verifiers and reasoning domains, indicating that native routing statistics preserve information about step-level reliability.

blocks.en: We then examine whether this routing information is competitive with conventional output-side confidence. We train lightweight bad-step predictors using either routing features or logit features and evaluate them with grouped cross-validation at the reasoning-trajectory level. Figure 1 (b) shows that routing-based predictors outperform their logit-based counterparts in 13 of 18 model–task–verifier settings. Together, the two analyses show that native routing not only tracks intermediate reasoning quality, but also provides a reliability signal that is often stronger than conventional output-side confidence.

blocks.en: 3.2 From Routing Statistics to Routing Confidence
blocks.zh: 3.2 从例行统计到例行信任

blocks.en: Building on the routing-confidence signal defined in Section 3.2 , we introduce RoCo ( Ro uting Co nfidence; Figure 2 ), a framework that turns native MoE routing into step-level reasoning guidance and process supervision. After each regeneration, we recompute routing confidence over the updated trajectory and select the currently least confident step for the next rethink round. We terminate when the prediction stabilizes across successive rounds or when a predefined maximum number of rethink rounds is reached. The final output is determined using task-appropriate aggregation or convergence criteria, detailed in Appendix C . In this way, RoCo-Rethink turns native routing information into a direct step-selection signal for targeted reasoning revision without requiring a separately trained process evaluator.

Given a target-model trajectory, the PRM scores each reasoning prefix, the lowest-scoring step is selected as the revision point, and the target model regenerates the subsequent trajectory conditioned on the preserved prefix. blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models and Benchmarks. For RoCo-Rethink, we evaluate three MoE models: DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat ( Liu et al., 2024 , hereafter DeepSeek) , OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-SFT ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 , OLMoE) , and Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat ( Qwen Team, 2024 , Qwen1.5) . Each model derives routing confidence from its native expert-routing behavior for selective reasoning revision. For RoCo-PRM, we evaluate the resulting PRM on these three MoE models and two dense models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025 , Qwen2.5) and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Dubey et al., 2024 , Llama) , allowing us to assess whether routing-derived supervision transfers beyond MoE architectures.

blocks.en: We evaluate six benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning, knowledge reasoning, code generation, instruction following, and logical reasoning: GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) , MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) , HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and LogicBench ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) . For PRM training, supervision data are constructed from training datasets that are disjoint from the corresponding evaluation sets, with dataset-specific sources detailed in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Baselines. For test-time reasoning guidance, we compare RoCo-Rethink with Vanilla decoding, Self-Consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and LECO ( Yao et al., 2024 ) . Self-Consistency aggregates multiple sampled reasoning trajectories, while LECO uses generation-logit-based confidence to identify low-confidence steps for selective regeneration. For process supervision, we compare RoCo-PRM with MC-PRM ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , which estimates step quality through Monte Carlo rollouts, and CPMI-PRM ( Lee et al., 2026a ) , which derives process rewards from contrastive mutual information between reasoning steps and target answers.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. All experiments are repeated with five random seeds, and we report the mean and standard deviation. For RoCo-Rethink, the initial response is generated greedily and subsequent rethink rounds regenerate from the least confident reasoning step. For RoCo-PRM, we use Qwen3-30B-A3B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as the routing teacher and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the PRM backbone. At evaluation time, all learned PRMs use the same step-level rethink protocol: the lowest-scoring step is selected as the revision point, and the target model regenerates the suffix from the preserved prefix. Detailed implementation settings are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the main results.
blocks.zh: 表1总结了主要结果。

blocks.en: RoCo-Rethink achieves the best performance in all 18 model–task settings across the three MoE models. On average, it improves over the strongest test-time baseline by 1.2, 1.9, and 1.5 points on OLMoE, DeepSeek, and Qwen1.5, respectively. Compared with Vanilla decoding, the corresponding average gains are 4.5, 4.8, and 4.5 points. The improvements span mathematical reasoning, code generation, knowledge reasoning, instruction following, and logical reasoning, showing that routing confidence provides a broadly effective signal for selective reasoning revision.

blocks.en: RoCo-PRM achieves the best or tied-best performance in all 30 model–task settings across the five evaluation models, with 29 strict wins and one tie. Compared with the strongest PRM baseline, it improves average performance by 1.7, 1.5, and 1.5 points on OLMoE, DeepSeek, and Qwen1.5, respectively. The gains also transfer to dense models: RoCo-PRM improves over the strongest baseline by 1.4 points on Qwen2.5 and 1.6 points on Llama. These results demonstrate that routing-derived supervision remains effective across both MoE and dense target models.

blocks.en: 6.2 RoCo-Rethink Uses Test-Time Rethink Budget More Effectively
blocks.zh: 6.2 RoCo-Rethink uses Test-Time 重新思考预算

blocks.en: We analyze how effectively different rethink methods convert additional test-time budget into performance gains. We vary the maximum number of rethink rounds from 0 to 3 and report the mean gain over Vanilla on four benchmarks: GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU, and LogicBench. For each model–task pair, we compute the gain relative to Vanilla and average these gains across tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们分析不同的重新思考方法如何有效地将额外的试验时间预算转化为业绩收益。 我们将重新思考的最大回合数从0到3,并以4个基准报告比瓦尼拉的平均收益:GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU和Logic Bench。 对于每个模型任务组合,我们计算相对于香草的增益,并平均计算各项任务的增益。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Test-time rethink-budget scaling. RoCo-Rethink consistently yields larger gains than LECO and random rethink across all three MoE models.
blocks.zh: 图5:试验时间反思-预算规模。 RoCo-Rethink 持续产生比LECO更大的收益,并随机重新思考所有三个MOE模型.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that RoCo-Rethink consistently delivers larger gains than both LECO and random rethink under the same rethink-round budget. On OLMoE, the average gain of RoCo-Rethink increases from 2.9 at one rethink round to 4.7 at three rounds, compared with 1.9 to 3.7 for LECO. On DeepSeek, the corresponding gains are 3.2 to 5.6 for RoCo-Rethink and 1.4 to 3.4 for LECO. On Qwen1.5, RoCo-Rethink improves from 2.5 to 4.4, whereas LECO improves from 1.3 to 2.8. Random rethink yields only small and less stable gains across all models.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,RoCo-Rethink在同样的重新思考周期预算下,始终比LECO和随机重新思考都带来更大的收益。 在OLMOE上,RoCo-Rethink的平均收益从一次重新思考回合的2.9增加到三回合的4.7,而LECO则从1.9增加到3.7. 在DeepSeek上,相应的收益是RoCo-Rethink的3.2至5.6,LECO的1.4至3.4. 在Quen1.5上,RoCo-Rethink从2.5改进为4.4,而LECO则从1.3改进为2.8. 随机的重新思考只产生小的、不太稳定的收益。

blocks.en: These results show that RoCo-Rethink not only achieves stronger final performance, but also converts additional rethink rounds into performance gains more effectively. Substantial improvements already emerge at low rethink budgets, indicating that routing confidence allocates extra test-time reasoning more effectively than logit-based confidence.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,RoCo-Re think不仅能实现更强大的最终性能,而且能将额外的反思回合转化为更有效的性能收益. 低水平的重新思考预算已经出现重大改进,表明路线自信比基于登录的信心更有效地分配额外的试验时间推理。

blocks.en: 6.3 RoCo-PRM Is More Sensitive to Teacher Quality than Backbone Scale
blocks.zh: 6.3 农药管制委员会 对教师质量的敏感度大于 Backbone 比例

blocks.en: We next examine whether RoCo-PRM is more strongly affected by the routing teacher or by the capacity of the standalone PRM. We vary the routing teacher while fixing the PRM backbone, and separately vary the PRM backbone while fixing the routing teacher.

blocks.en: We first fix the PRM backbone to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and compare routing supervision generated by DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Using Qwen3 as the routing teacher yields an average improvement of 2.0 points over DeepSeek across the 30 model–task settings. The gain is consistent across all five target models, ranging from 1.4 to 2.7 points in average score. These results indicate that the quality of routing-derived supervision has a substantial influence on the effectiveness of the resulting process evaluator.

blocks.en: 6.4 Routing-Derived Process Supervision Transfers Across Tasks
blocks.zh: 6.4 跨任务流程监督转移

blocks.en: Finally, we examine whether RoCo-PRM learns task-specific routing patterns or a more transferable notion of process quality. For each of four evaluation tasks (GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU, and HumanEval), we train a leave-one-task-out RoCo-PRM while excluding task-aligned routing supervision from the corresponding evaluation task. We then use the resulting PRM to guide three target models spanning both MoE and dense architectures.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们审查RoCo-PRM是学习具体任务的路由模式,还是学习一个更可转移的流程质量概念。 对于四个评价任务(GSM8K,MATH500,MMLU,和HumanEval)中的每一个任务,我们训练一个留守一任务的RoCo-PRM,同时将任务相配合的路由监督排除在相应的评价任务之外. 然后,我们利用由此产生的PRM指导三个目标模型,既包括教育部,也包括密集建筑。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows consistent cross-task transfer. Despite excluding task-aligned routing supervision for the evaluation task, the leave-one-task-out RoCo-PRMs improve performance in all 12 target-model–task settings, with an average gain of 1.98 1.98 points. The average gains reach 2.53 2.53 points on both MATH500 and GSM8K and 1.97 1.97 points on HumanEval. Transfer to MMLU is smaller, with an average gain of 0.87 0.87 points, but remains positive across all three target models. These results indicate that routing-derived process supervision captures signals that generalize beyond the task from which the supervision is collected.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced RoCo, a framework that turns native MoE routing into reasoning guidance and automatic process supervision. RoCo-Rethink uses routing confidence for targeted test-time revision, while RoCo-PRM distills routing-derived step scores into a standalone process evaluator that transfers across both MoE and dense models. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over strong test-time and PRM baselines, while further analyses link these gains to better revision-point selection, stronger routing teachers, and cross-task transfer of routing-derived supervision. Overall, our results establish expert routing as a practical, architecture-native source of process supervision and motivate broader exploration of internal computation signals for reasoning and learning.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了RoCo,这个框架将原生的MOE路由转化为推理指导和自动过程监督. RoCo-Rethink使用路由置信度进行有针对性的测试时间修订,而RoCo-PRM则将路由衍生的步数分数提炼成一个独立过程评价器,该评价器在教育部和密集模型之间进行传输。 广泛的实验表明,在强有力的试验时间和PRM基线方面,不断取得收益,同时进一步分析这些收益与更好的修订点选择、更强大的路由教师和跨任务转移路由监督联系起来。 总体而言,我们的成果将专家路线确定为一种实际的、结构化的流程监督来源,并激励更广泛地探索内部计算信号,以进行推理和学习。

The routing predictor uses the three step-level statistics introduced in Section 3.1 : overall routing mass ( M M ), head routing mass ( H H ), and within-step routing variation ( D D ). blocks.en: Both predictors use the same prediction pipeline consisting of median imputation, feature standardization, and logistic regression with balanced class weights and a maximum of 1,000 iterations. Within each trajectory, steps whose verifier scores fall at or below the 20th percentile are labeled as bad; trajectories with fewer than three valid steps are excluded. AUROC is computed from the out-of-fold predicted probability of the bad-step class over all valid steps. Across the 18 model–task–verifier settings shown in Figure 1 (b), the routing predictor outperforms the logit predictor in 13 settings. Table 4 reports the complete verifier-specific results.

blocks.en: C.1 Post-Hoc Revision Procedure
blocks.zh: C.1 选举后修订程序

blocks.en: RoCo-Rethink operates post hoc. The model first produces a complete reasoning trajectory, after which we replay the trajectory to extract router probabilities and compute routing confidence for every reasoning step. The lowest-confidence step is selected as the revision point. We preserve all reasoning steps preceding that point and regenerate the suffix beginning from the selected step. After each regeneration, routing confidence is recomputed over the updated trajectory and a new revision point is selected.
blocks.zh: RoCo-Rethink 运行后临时。 模型首先产生一个完整的推理轨迹,之后我们重放轨迹来提取路由器概率,并计算每个推理步骤的路由自信. 最低自信步骤被选为修订点. 我们保留了在该点之前的所有推理步骤,并从选定的步骤开始重现后缀。 每次再生后,对更新的轨迹重新计算出路由自信,并选择一个新的修订点.

blocks.en: E.3 PRM-Guided Rethink
blocks.zh: E.3 PRM指导性的反思

blocks.en: At test time, the trained PRM scores each reasoning prefix of a target-model trajectory. The scores are min–max normalized within the trajectory, and the lowest-scoring step is selected as the revision point. The target model then regenerates the suffix from that point using the same selective-rethink protocol as RoCo-Rethink. Because routing is used only to construct the teacher labels, the resulting PRM can guide dense models without access to target-model routing information.
blocks.zh: 在测试时间,训练有素的PRM对一个目标模型轨迹的每个推理前缀进行评分. 得分在轨迹内为分钟-最大正常化,最低得分步骤被选为修订点. 目标模型然后利用与RoCo-Rethink相同的选择性再思考协议从这时起再生后缀. 由于路由只用于构建师资标签,由此产生的PRM可以引导密集的模型,而无需访问目标模型路由信息.

blocks.en: Appendix F PRM Baseline Details
blocks.zh: 附录F PRM 基线细节

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of supervision construction, MC-PRM, CPMI-PRM, and RoCo-PRM use the same Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct regression backbone and the same training recipe unless otherwise stated. All three methods therefore differ primarily in how their step-level supervision targets are constructed.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离监管建设的效果,MC-PRM,CPMI-PRM,RoCo-PRM使用相同的Quen2.5-7B-指令回归主干线和相同的培训配方,除非另有说明. 因此,这三种方法在如何构建其分级监督目标方面主要不同。

blocks.en: F.1 MC-PRM
blocks.zh: F.1 MC-PRM系统

blocks.en: MC-PRM estimates the quality of each reasoning prefix through Monte Carlo continuation. Given a prefix s ≤ i s_{\leq i} , we append it to the original problem prompt and sample K = 8 K=8 continuation suffixes using Qwen3-30B-A3B with temperature 0.7 0.7 and top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 . The maximum generation length is task dependent: 256 tokens for GSM8K, 512 for MATH500, 128 for MMLU, and 256 for LogicBench.
blocks.zh: MC-PRM通过蒙特卡洛续作来估计每个推理前缀的质量. 鉴于一个前缀s i s_{\leq i},我们把它附加在最初的问题即时和样本K = 8 K = 8 续后缀上,使用Qwen3-30B-A3B,温度0.7,顶端-p = 0.95 p=0. 最大生成长度取决于任务:GSM8K的256个符,MATH500的512个符,MMLU的128个符,Logic Bench的256个符.

blocks.en: Let y ^ i ( k ) \hat{y}_{i}^{(k)} denote the outcome obtained from the k k -th rollout from prefix s ≤ i s_{\leq i} . The MC supervision target is y i MC = 1 K ​ ∑ k = 1 K 𝕀 ⁡ [ y ^ i ( k ) ​ is correct ] , K = 8 . y_{i}^{\mathrm{MC}}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\mathbb{I}\left[\hat{y}_{i}^{(k)}\text{ is correct}\right],\qquad K=8. (19)
blocks.zh: 让 y ^ i (k)\ hat{i}_{i}^{(k)} 表示从 k k -th 推出 前缀 s i s_{\leq i} 得到的结果 。 MC监督目标为y i MC = 1 K → k = 1 K I → [y ^ i (k)正确],K = 8. y_{i}^{\ mathrm{ MC}}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\mathbb{i}\i}\左[\i{i}^{(k)}\text{{ 正确}\右],\qquad K=8. (19).

blocks.en: Correctness is determined using the task-specific evaluator. For GSM8K and MATH500, we extract and normalize the final numerical answer. For MMLU, we extract the final A–D option, while LogicBench BQA uses the final yes/no answer. For HumanEval, each code prefix is completed to a full program and evaluated with the official HumanEval execution harness; the target is the fraction of rollouts that pass the unit tests. For IFEval, each rollout is evaluated with the official instruction-following checker, and strict prompt-level compliance is used to construct the MC-PRM supervision target. Loose prompt-level accuracy is retained as the evaluation metric reported in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 正确性由特定任务评价员确定。 对于GSM8K和MATH500,我们提取并规范了最后的数字答案. 对于MMLU,我们提取最终的A-D选项,而Logic Bench BQA则使用最终的是/否答案. 对于HumanEval,每个代码前缀都完成到一个完整的程序,并用官方的HumanEval执行带来评价;目标就是通过单元测试的推出的一小部分. 对IFEval来说,每次推出都要使用官方指令跟踪检查器进行评估,并且采用严格的即时合规来构建MC-PRM监督目标. 在主要实验中作为评价衡量标准,保留了迅速水平的准确性。

blocks.en: The resulting target lies in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and is used to train the same Qwen2.5-7B scalar-regression PRM architecture as RoCo-PRM.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的目标位于[0,1] [0,1],用于训练与RoCo-PRM相同的Quen2.5-7B scalar-reression PRM架构.

blocks.en: F.2 CPMI-PRM
blocks.zh: F.2 CPMI-PRM

blocks.en: CPMI-PRM measures the incremental evidence contributed by the current reasoning step toward a correct target relative to plausible incorrect alternatives. For a candidate target y y , define Δ i ​ ( y ) = ℓ ⁡ ( y ∣ x , s ≤ i ) − ℓ ⁡ ( y ∣ x , s < i ) , \Delta_{i}(y)=\ell(y\mid x,s_{\leq i})-\ell(y\mid x,s_{<i}), (20) where ℓ \ell denotes the mean token log-probability of the target continuation. We compute these values using Qwen3-30B-A3B with vLLM prompt log-probabilities. The use of mean rather than summed token log-probability reduces sensitivity to target length.
blocks.zh: CPMI-PRM衡量与可能不正确的替代品相比,目前朝着正确目标迈出的推理步骤所产生的增量证据。 对于一个候选目标y,定义 i (y) = l (y ×, s i) − (y ×, s i) − (y ×, s < i),\Delta_{i}(y) → ell (y\mid x, s_{\leq i}) -\ ell (y\mid x, s_{<i}),其中 l\ ell 表示目标续作的平均符号日志概率. 我们使用 Qune3- 30B- A3B 计算这些值,并带有 vLLM 即时日志概率 。 使用刻意而非概括的符号日志概率会降低目标长度的灵敏度.

blocks.en: For a positive target y + y^{+} and a negative set 𝒩 \mathcal{N} , we define s i CPMI = Δ i ​ ( y + ) − 1 | 𝒩 | ​ ∑ y − ∈ 𝒩 Δ i ​ ( y − ) , s_{i}^{\mathrm{CPMI}}=\Delta_{i}(y^{+})-\frac{1}{|\mathcal{N}|}\sum_{y^{-}\in\mathcal{N}}\Delta_{i}(y^{-}), (21) and convert the score to a bounded regression target, y i CPMI = σ ⁡ ( s i CPMI ) , y_{i}^{\mathrm{CPMI}}=\sigma\!\left(s_{i}^{\mathrm{CPMI}}\right), (22) corresponding to a scaling factor γ = 1 \gamma=1 .

For GSM8K and MATH500, negatives are numerical perturbations of the gold answer. We prioritize offsets of + 1 +1 , − 1 -1 , + 2 +2 , and − 2 -2 , followed by sign reversal, multiplicative perturbations ( 1.1 × 1.1\times and 0.9 × 0.9\times ), and simple constants such as 0 0 , 1 1 , and − 1 -1 , retaining at most four negatives. For MMLU, the three non-gold answer choices form the negative set. For LogicBench BQA, the opposite Boolean answer is used as the negative.
blocks.zh: 对GSM8K和MATH500来说,负数是黄金答案的数值扰动. 我们优先抵消+1+1,+1+2,+2+2,以及−2-2,然后是标志反转,多重扰动(1.1×1.1+时和0.9×0.9+时),简单常数如0-0,1-1,和−1-1,最多保留4个负数. 对于MMLU,三个非金色的答案选择组成了负数集. 对于 Logic Bench BQA,相反的布尔答案作为负数使用.

blocks.en: For code generation, the CPMI target is defined over executable completions rather than short answer strings. A passing completion serves as the positive target, while negatives are execution-failing completions drawn from model-sampled failures, previously generated incorrect completions for the same problem, and syntactically valid programs that fail the unit tests. Because code completions can vary substantially in length, we use mean token log-probability and construct positive and negative targets with approximately matched lengths whenever possible. The same incremental-evidence formulation is then applied to these completion-level targets.
blocks.zh: 对于代码生成,CPMI目标的定义是相对于可执行的完成,而不是短答字符串. 顺利完成是正目标,而负数则是从模型样本的失败中提取的执行失败完成,以前对同一问题产生的不正确的完成,以及未能完成单位测试的协同有效的程序. 由于代码完成的长度可能有很大的差别,我们使用平均符号对数概率,并尽可能构建约匹配长度的正负目标. 然后对这些完成水平目标采用同样的递增证据表述。

blocks.en: For instruction following, we use a constraint-aware completion-level CPMI construction. Candidate responses are generated from the same teacher-model family and filtered with the official IFEval checker. Responses satisfying the constraints are used as positive targets, while failed responses form the negative pool. We retain approximately one to three positives and three to eight negatives per prompt when available, with preference for negatives that are fluent but violate only a small subset of constraints. We further stratify IFEval negatives by failure severity. Hard negatives violate only one constraint, medium negatives satisfy part of the instruction set but still fail the final checker, and easy negatives exhibit more obvious non-compliance. CPMI construction prioritizes hard and medium negatives to reduce the risk that the PRM merely learns to distinguish generally poor responses from instruction-compliant ones. For a response prefix s ≤ i s_{\leq i} , candidate scoring is performed only on the remaining continuation rather than replaying the full response, avoiding duplication between the observed prefix and the candidate completion. Positive candidates are defined primarily using strict IFEval compliance; loose compliance is used only when insufficient strict positives are available. Candidate metadata retains strict and loose pass indicators together with per-instruction failure information.
blocks.zh: 对于后续指令,我们使用一种具有约束意识的完成级CPMI构建. 候选人的回答来自同一个教师模范家庭,并通过IFEval官方检查器过滤. 满足这些制约因素的对策被用作积极目标,而失败的对策则构成消极因素。 我们保留了大约1至3个正数和每秒3至8个负数,优先选择流利但只违反一小部分限制的负数。 我们进一步通过失败的严重程度来划分IFEval的负数。 硬底片只违反一个约束,中底片满足了指令集的一部分,但仍然未能完成最终的检查器,容易的底片表现出更明显的不遵守. CPMI建设将硬和中度负数列为优先事项,以减少风险,即PRM只学会区分一般反应差和遵守指令的反应。 对于响应前缀s ≤i s_{\leq i},考生的评分只在剩余续作上进行,而不是重播全部的应答,避免重复观察前缀和考生完成. 积极候选人的定义主要采用严格遵守《国际家庭教育准则》;只有在没有足够严格的积极因素时才采用松散的遵守。 候选元数据保留了严格和松散的通过指标以及按指示操作失败信息。

blocks.en: Across all tasks, CPMI-derived scalar targets are used to train the same Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct regression PRM with the same LoRA and optimization configuration as RoCo-PRM and MC-PRM.
blocks.zh: 在所有任务中,CPMI衍生的scalar目标都用于训练与RoCo-PRM和MC-PRM相同的Quen2.5-7B-指令回归PRM,并优化配置.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional RoCo-PRM Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录G 分析

blocks.en: G.1 Teacher and Backbone Ablations
blocks.zh: G.1 教师和背骨缺陷

blocks.en: We provide the complete results underlying the teacher- and backbone-ablation analysis in the main paper. To isolate the effect of routing-teacher quality, we first fix the PRM backbone to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and compare supervision generated by DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat and Qwen3-30B-A3B. As shown in Table 13 , using Qwen3 as the routing teacher improves the average score by 2.0 points across the 30 target-model–task settings. The improvement is consistent across all five target models, with average gains ranging from 1.4 to 2.7 points.
blocks.zh: 我们在主要论文中提供了教师和骨干分析的完整结果。 为了隔离路由-教师质量的影响,我们首先将PRM主干线固定到Quen2.5-7B-指令,并比较DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat和Quen3-30B-A3B产生的监督. 如表13所示,使用Quen3作为路线教师,在30个目标模式-任务设置中将平均分提高2.0分。 所有五个目标模式的改善一致,平均收益从1.4点到2.7点不等。

blocks.en: Table 13: Effect of routing-teacher quality on RoCo-PRM. The PRM backbone is fixed to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Results are reported as mean scores; standard deviations are omitted for readability.
blocks.zh: 表13:路线-教师质量对RoCo-PRM的影响。 PRM主干线固定为Quen2.5-7B-Instruct. 结果作为平均分数报告;可读性省略标准差。

blocks.en: We next fix Qwen3-30B-A3B as the routing teacher and vary the standalone PRM backbone between Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Table 14 shows that increasing the PRM backbone size yields a substantially smaller average gain of 0.90 points across the same 30 settings, with per-model improvements ranging from 0.55 to 1.53 points.
blocks.zh: 接下来将Qwen3-30B-A3B修复为路由师,并在Quen2.5-1.5B-Instruct和Quen2.5-7B-Instruct之间改变独立的PRM骨干. 表14显示,PRM主干线规模的提高,在相同的30个设置中平均收益0.90分,而每个模型的改进幅度在0.55至1.53分之间。

blocks.en: Table 14: Effect of PRM backbone scale. The routing teacher is fixed to Qwen3-30B-A3B. Results are reported as mean scores; standard deviations are omitted for readability.
blocks.zh: 表14:PRM主干级的影响。 线路教师固定为Quen3-30B-A3B. 结果作为平均分数报告;可读性省略标准差。

blocks.en: Overall, these results consistently indicate that RoCo-PRM is more sensitive to the quality of routing-derived supervision than to the capacity of the downstream PRM. This suggests that improving the routing teacher is more effective than simply scaling the process evaluator.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,RoCo-PRM对路由式监督的质量比对下游PRM的能力更敏感。 这表明,改进路由教师比简单地扩大流程评估工作更有效。

blocks.en: G.2 Leave-One-Task-Out Cross-Task Generalization
blocks.zh: G.2 单任务任务外包

blocks.en: We further evaluate whether routing-derived process supervision transfers across tasks rather than merely capturing task-specific routing patterns. We construct four leave-one-task-out (LOO) RoCo-PRMs corresponding to GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU, and HumanEval. For each evaluation task, we exclude its task-aligned routing supervision from PRM training and train Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the remaining routing-labeled sources. The resulting PRM therefore receives no task-aligned routing supervision from the corresponding evaluation task.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价由路由产生的流程监督跨任务转移,而不是仅仅掌握具体任务的路由模式。 我们建造了四个单任务(LOO) RoCo-PRMs,对应GSM8K,MATH500,MMLU,和HumanEval. 对于每项评估任务,我们将其与任务相匹配的路由监督从PRM培训和对其余路由标签来源的Quen2.5-7B列车中排除。 因此,由此产生的方案主管机构没有从相应的评价任务中接受与任务相匹配的路由监督。

blocks.en: The underlying supervision pool is constructed from GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, APPS, MBPP, and IFEval. As in the main RoCo-PRM experiments, each reasoning prefix is paired with its routing-derived confidence target, and the appropriate task-specific prompt format is retained during PRM training. All LOO PRMs use the same scalar-regression architecture and optimization recipe as the default RoCo-PRM. We train for one epoch in BF16 with DeepSpeed Stage 2, a maximum sequence length of 1,024, learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , per-device batch size 1, gradient accumulation 32, and four training processes.
blocks.zh: 基本监管池由GSM8K、MATH、MMLU、APPS、MBPP和IFEval建造。 与主要的RoCo-PRM实验一样,每个推理前缀都与它的路由衍生的置信目标配对,在PRM训练中保留适当的特定任务快速格式. 所有LOOPRM都使用与默认的RoCo-PRM相同的scalar-reression架构和优化配方. 我们在BF16训练一个时代,深射阶段2,最大序列长度为1,024,学习速度2×10−4 2\times 10×4},每装置批量尺寸1,梯度累积32,以及四个训练过程.

blocks.en: At evaluation time, each LOO PRM is used to guide the corresponding held-out task on three target models: OLMoE, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Table 15 reports the complete results underlying Figure 6 .
blocks.zh: 在评价时,每个LOOPRM都用于指导三个目标模型上相应的搁置任务:OLMoE,Quen2.5-7B-Instruct,以及Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. 表15报告了图6的完整结果。

blocks.en: Table 15: Full leave-one-task-out cross-task generalization results. Each RoCo-PRM is trained without task-aligned routing supervision from the corresponding evaluation task. Values show target-model performance before and after LOO RoCo-PRM guidance.
blocks.zh: 表15 全面休假一任务外跨任务概括结果. 每一个RoCo-PRM都经过培训,没有从相应的评价任务中进行与任务相匹配的路由监督. 价值在LOO RoCo-PRM指导前后显示目标模型性能.

blocks.en: The LOO RoCo-PRMs improve performance in all 12 target-model–task settings, with an average gain of 1.98 1.98 points. The strongest average transfer gains are observed on MATH500 and GSM8K, both at + 2.53 +2.53 points, followed by HumanEval at + 1.97 +1.97 points. MMLU exhibits a smaller average gain of + 0.87 +0.87 points, but the improvement remains positive for all three target models. These results provide additional evidence that routing-derived process supervision captures transferable process-level information rather than being limited to task-specific routing patterns.
blocks.zh: LOO RoCo-PRMS改进了所有12个目标模式任务设置的性能,平均收益1.98 1.98分. 在MATH500和GSM8K上观测到的最强平均转移增益,均在+2.53+2.53点,其次是HumanEval在+1.97+1.97点. MMLU显示的平均增益较小,为+0.87+0.87分,但对于所有三种目标模型来说,改进仍然是积极的. 这些结果提供了进一步的证据,表明路由衍生的流程监督能够获取可转移的流程层面信息,而不是局限于特定任务的路由模式。

blocks.en: Appendix H Prompting, Parsing, and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录H 提示、分析和评价细节

blocks.en: H.1 Task-Specific Prompting
blocks.zh: H.1 特定任务提示

blocks.en: For GSM8K and MATH500, the user message is the original problem statement provided by the benchmark. For chat models, we wrap this message using the model tokenizer’s native chat template with generation enabled. When no chat template is available, we use the fallback prompt: Question: {question} Answer: Let’s think step by step. The same prompting policy is used when reconstructing problem–prefix inputs for routing extraction and rethink inference.
blocks.zh: 对于GSM8K和MATH500,用户信息是基准提供的原始问题说明. 对于聊天模式, 我们使用模型的标致器的本地聊天模板来包装此消息, 并启用生成 。 当没有聊天模板时,我们使用倒计时提示: 问题 : {问题} 回答:让我们一步一步地思考。 在重建问题时也采用了同样的提示政策 — — 用于路由提取和再思考推论的前置输入.

blocks.en: For MMLU, the user message contains the benchmark-formatted multiple-choice question together with four labeled answer options and an instruction to return the corresponding option letter. The generated response is evaluated by extracting a prediction from { A , B , C , D } \{A,B,C,D\} .
blocks.zh: 对于MMLU,用户信息包含基准格式的多选择问题,以及四个标注的答案选项和一个返回相应选项字母的指示. 生成的响应通过从 {A,B,C,D} 中提取一个预测来评价.

blocks.en: For LogicBench BQA, we use the following task-specific prompt ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) : Answer the following logic question. Think briefly, then give the final answer as yes or no. Context: {context} Question: {question} Final answer: This task-specific prompt is then wrapped with the model’s native chat template for chat-based models.
blocks.zh: 对于 Logic Bench BQA, 我们使用以下特定任务提示(Parmar等人, 2024年) : 回答以下逻辑问题. 简单想想,最后回答为是或否。 上下文 : { context} 问题 : {问题} 最后答复: 这个任务特定的提示随后被模型的本地聊天模板包裹,用于聊天模式.

blocks.en: For HumanEval, we use the canonical benchmark continuation prompt consisting of the original function signature and docstring. We do not apply a chat template; generated code is appended directly to the benchmark prompt. Generation uses code-oriented stop sequences to avoid unrelated trailing text or subsequent function/class definitions.
blocks.zh: 对于HumanEval,我们使用由原始函数签名和docstring构成的犬形基准续集. 我们不应用聊天模板;生成的代码直接附在基准提示上. 生成使用面向代码的停止序列来避免无关的后缀文本或随后的函数/类定义.

blocks.en: For IFEval, the original instruction-following prompt is used directly as the user message and wrapped with the model tokenizer’s native chat template. We add no task-specific answer-format instruction.
blocks.zh: 对 IFEval 来说, 原始的跟随指令的提示直接作为用户消息使用, 并用模型的标致器的本地聊天模板包裹 。 我们没有添加针对特定任务的答案格式指示。

blocks.en: Because chat templates differ across model families, we describe the prompting policy rather than hard-coding model-specific special tokens. Within each benchmark, all compared methods use the same base prompt; methods differ only in how reasoning steps are scored or selected for revision.
blocks.zh: 由于各模范家庭的聊天模板不同,我们描述的是激励政策,而不是硬编码模式特有的特殊标志. 在每个基准内,所有比较方法都使用相同的基数即时;方法仅在推理步骤如何得分或如何选择修订方面有所不同.

blocks.en: H.2 Reasoning-Step Segmentation
blocks.zh: H.2 理由分解

blocks.en: For natural-language reasoning tasks, reasoning steps are defined as newline-delimited non-empty text blocks. Empty spans are discarded, and if a response contains no newline boundary, the complete non-empty response is treated as a single step. Tokenizer offset mappings are used to align generated tokens with their corresponding text spans for step-level routing and logit aggregation. Character offsets are retained for each step and used to map generated tokens to their corresponding step spans.
blocks.zh: 对于自然语言推理任务,推理步骤被定义为新线限定的非空文本块. 空跨被丢弃,如果一个响应没有包含新线边界,则完整的非空跨响应作为单步处理. Tokenizer 抵消映射用于将生成的符号与其相应的文本跨度对齐,用于阶梯级路由和登录汇总. 每个步骤都保留字符偏移,并用来将生成的符号映射到相应的步长。

blocks.en: HumanEval follows the analogous rule at the code level: each non-empty source-code line is treated as a reasoning/code step. This preserves syntactic line structure when selecting a revision point and reconstructing the preserved code prefix.
blocks.zh: HumanEval在代码级别上遵循类似的规则:每条非空源代码线作为推理/代码步骤处理. 这保留了在选择修订点和重建保存的代码前缀时的合成线条结构.

blocks.en: H.3 Answer Extraction
blocks.zh: H.3 答复提取

blocks.en: Task-specific answer extraction is applied consistently across Vanilla, rethink-based methods, and PRM-guided inference.
blocks.zh: 任务特定答案提取在万尼拉、基于反思的方法和由PRM指导的推论中一致应用。

blocks.en: For GSM8K and MATH500, we prioritize the last well-formed \boxed{...} expression, followed by the #### marker, “The answer is” patterns, and the last numerical expression in the response as a fallback. Extracted numerical strings are normalized by removing commas and canonicalizing finite integer or floating-point representations before comparison with the reference answer.
blocks.zh: 对于GSM8K和MATH500,我们优先排列最后的成型的\boxed{...}表达式,然后是QQ标记的“答案是”模式,最后的数字表达式作为倒置。 抽取的数值字符串通过去除逗号,在与参考答案进行比较之前将有限整数或浮动点表示法(cononication)实现正常化.

blocks.en: For MMLU, we extract an answer from { A , B , C , D } \{A,B,C,D\} . For LogicBench BQA, we extract the final yes/no decision, using the last Boolean answer when necessary. The task-specific scoring implementations then compare the extracted prediction with the gold label.
blocks.zh: 对于MMLU,我们从{A,B,C,D}中提取一个答案. 对于 Logic Bench BQA,我们提取最后的是/否决定,必要时使用最后的布尔答案. 任务特定的评分执行然后将提取的预测与金色标签进行比较.

blocks.en: H.4 HumanEval Evaluation
blocks.zh: H.4 人文评价

blocks.en: For HumanEval, model outputs are converted into executable code completions before evaluation. If a response contains a Markdown code block, its code content is extracted; duplicated benchmark prompt text is removed when present. Generation uses code-oriented stopping sequences including subsequent function or class definitions.
blocks.zh: 对于HumanEval,模型输出在评价前转换为可执行代码完成. 如果一个响应包含一个Markdown代码块,则其代码内容被提取;重复的基准即时文本在出现时被删除. 生成使用面向代码的停止序列,包括后续函数或类定义.

blocks.en: We evaluate the resulting completions using the official human_eval functional-correctness harness and report pass@1. Evaluation uses eight worker processes and a 10-second execution timeout per completion. For rethink-based methods, the preserved code prefix and regenerated suffix are combined before execution, so correctness is always measured on the final complete program.
blocks.zh: 我们使用官方的人类-eval功能校正控制并报告通过@1. 评价采用8个工人流程,每次完成10秒的执行暂停。 对于基于重新思考的方法,保存的代码前缀和再生成的后缀在执行前是合并的,所以正确性总是在最终的完整程序上测量的.

blocks.en: H.5 IFEval Evaluation
blocks.zh: H.5 IFEval评价

blocks.en: IFEval responses are evaluated using the official instruction-following checker under both strict and loose criteria. The evaluator records prompt-level compliance, instruction-level compliance, and per-instruction pass/fail outcomes for both variants.
blocks.zh: 根据严格和宽松的标准,使用官方指示跟踪检查器对IFEval的答复进行评估。 评价人员记录了两种变式的及时合规、指令合规和按指示办理的通行证/故障结果。

blocks.en: The main paper reports loose prompt accuracy . For process-supervision construction, however, we use the strict criterion to define rollout correctness and positive completion candidates, yielding a more conservative supervision signal. Loose outcomes are retained for evaluation and analysis but are not used as the primary supervision criterion.
blocks.zh: 主报报道的迅速准确度不高。 然而,对于流程监督建设,我们使用严格的标准来定义推出的正确性和正完成的候选性,从而产生更保守的监督信号. 剩余结果保留用于评价和分析,但不作为主要监督标准。

blocks.en: Appendix I Qualitative Examples
blocks.zh: 附录一 定性实例

blocks.en: We provide representative examples illustrating both successful and unsuccessful RoCo-Rethink revisions.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了一些有代表性的例子,说明对RoCo-Rethink的修订既成功又失败。

blocks.en: Original suffix. The red ties cost 50% more than blue ties, so the cost of the red ties is 1.5 × $ 40 = $ 60 1.5\times\$40=\$60 each. He spent $200 on blue ties, so he spent $200 − - $40 = $160 on red ties. The total cost of all the ties is $160 + $200 = $360.
blocks.zh: 原文后缀. 红色领带比蓝色领带多出50%,因此红色领带的成本为1.5×40美元=60 1.5×40×60美元. 他在蓝色领带上花费了200美元,所以在红色领带上花费了200 - - -40美元=160美元. 所有领带的总成本为160美元+200美元=360美元.

blocks.en: Regenerated reasoning. After preserving the prefix before Step 2, the model instead reasons that $200 spent on $40 blue ties corresponds to five blue ties, hence ten red ties. At $60 per red tie, the red ties cost $600, giving a total expenditure of $800.
blocks.zh: 重新生成推理. 在保留了第2步之前的前缀之后,模型反而说明花费在40块蓝色领带上的200块相当于5块蓝色领带,因此有10块红色领带. 每红领带60美元,红领带花费600美元,使总支出达到800美元.

blocks.en: Answer trajectory. 360 → 500 → 800 → 800 360\rightarrow 500\rightarrow 800\rightarrow 800 .

The example illustrates that RoCo-Rethink need not correct the trajectory in a single regeneration. The first revision alters the continuation but remains incorrect, while a subsequent low-confidence revision produces the correct reasoning path and the stopping rule terminates once the answer stabilizes.
blocks.zh: 这个例子表明,RoCo-Rethink不需要在一次再生中纠正轨迹. 第一次修订修改了续作,但依然不正确,而随后的低信心修订则产生正确的推理路径,停止规则在回答稳定后终止.

blocks.en: Table 17 presents a contrasting GSM8K example in which RoCo-Rethink identifies a low-confidence revision point but fails to escape the original erroneous reasoning path. The model incorrectly treats the 150% increase as applying to the total purchase-and-repair cost, producing a final answer of $195,000 instead of the gold profit of $70,000. RoCo-Rethink selects Step 3 as the lowest-confidence step, with C i = − 0.569 C_{i}=-0.569 , but regeneration reproduces the same suffix and therefore leaves the final answer unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表17给出了一个具有对比性的GSM8K实例,其中RoCo-Rethink识别出一个低自信的修订点,但未能逃脱最初的错误推理路径. 该型号错误地将150%的涨价视为适用于总的购修费用,最终答案为19.5万美元,而不是黄金利润7万美元. RoCo-Reministry选择第3步为最低自信步骤,其中C i = − 0.569 C _{i}= - 0.569,但再生会复制相同的后缀,因此最终答案不变.

blocks.en: Table 17: RoCo-Rethink failure case on GSM8K. The selected revision point is highlighted in bold. Although the selector identifies the lowest-confidence step, regeneration reproduces the original erroneous continuation.
blocks.zh: 表17:GSM8K上的RoCo-Rethink故障案例. 选定的修订点用黑体突出显示。 虽然选择器识别出最小的自信步骤,但再生复制了原来的错误的延续.

blocks.en: Original suffix. Josh sold the house for $325,000, so his profit is $325,000 − - $130,000 = $195,000.
blocks.zh: 原文后缀. 乔希以325,000美元的价格卖掉了房子,因此他的利润为325,000 — — 13万美元=195,000美元.

blocks.en: Regenerated suffix. The regenerated suffix is identical to the original suffix, and the predicted answer remains 195000.
blocks.zh: 重生成后缀. 重新生成的后缀与原来的后缀完全相同,预测的答案仍然是1500.

blocks.en: This failure case highlights an important limitation of selective rethink: identifying a low-confidence revision point does not guarantee that regeneration will leave the original reasoning basin. In this example, the generation process returns the same erroneous continuation, resulting in a W2W transition.
blocks.zh: 这一失败案例凸显出选择性反思的一个重要局限性:确定低信心修订点并不能保证再生会离开原推理盆地. 在这个例子中,生成过程返回同样的错误续作,导致W2W的过渡.
